name: pomerium-upstream-tls-e2e
description: Container-based E2E tests for Pomerium upstream TLS/mTLS route options (tls_custom_ca, tls_client_cert, tls_server_name, tls_skip_verify, ...): testcontainers + real Keycloak IdP + a first-party Node TLS/mTLS echo upstream, against the official pomerium/pomerium container.
